rules.treatment: an unknown run keeps verdict=unknown and score_for_aggregate=null; it is excluded from both numerator and denominator of every aggregate
rules.never_a_failure: an unknown is not a product failure, not a zero, and not a full score computed from the already-evaluated part
rules.three_parts_required: impact (what the unknown blocks), next_action (what would resolve it), stop_condition (when to stop asking)
rules.review: each item is re-read at the date in review_by; an item may stay open only with an explicit stop condition

items.question: Can five-product differences be attributed to the Harness independently of model and Skill?
items.known: 25 end-to-end runs and 4 controlled arms are registered. None of the five products attests its backend model. The controlled track (scripted model response, one frozen MCP tool, identical arguments) removes model and Skill text from generation, so its differences are attributable to the transport/orchestration layer only. No five-product causal ranking exists.
items.impact: Blocks any ranking claim and any statement that a product's score difference is a Harness quality difference.
items.next_action: Reopen only with a supported interface that discloses the backend model of a product, so that one product can be probed both inside and outside its Harness with the same model.
items.stop_condition: Stop after the controlled component track is complete and published. Do not repeat GUI preflights or WorkBuddy calibrations; do not infer a model from a UI label.

items.question: What were the full artifact bytes exactly at the old 1200-second cutoff?
items.known: All 25 strict cutoff scores are null. No retained snapshot was taken at the old deadline, so later artifacts cannot stand in for it.
items.impact: No uniform-budget score and no speed comparison between products.
items.next_action: Accept only a contemporaneous snapshot with timestamps and matching hashes. A new run would need a newly registered snapshot protocol.
items.stop_condition: Stop inferring cutoff state from completion labels or eventual file mtimes.

items.question: Do the three GUI products meet an internal read/write/error contract that can be observed from outside?
items.known: Native artifacts and reviewed UI support an end-to-end observation. WorkBuddy exposes a custom endpoint and a local stdio MCP, but three calibrations never reached a shared tool call; Yuanbao showed no shared endpoint in the inspected menus; Doubao's custom connector applies to the local computer while the tested entrance was the cloud computer.
items.impact: Internal tool-call evidence stays unknown for the three GUI products, so their end-to-end scores cannot be split into tool-layer and model-layer contributions.
items.next_action: Only a supported metadata or schema source would reopen this. A declaration is not a dispatch.
items.stop_condition: Stop repeating UI captures for this question. Reopen only with a new supported evidence source.

items.question: Has an independent human reproduced the two key conclusions?
items.known: The repository ships a reproducible experiment for each conclusion, and CI re-runs the whole offline audit. That is machine reproducibility, not a second human reviewer. No external feedback has been received.
items.impact: Single-operator collection with AI assistance remains a limitation of the whole submission.
items.next_action: Any reviewer can run the two commands in docs/ledger.md and compare the printed hashes. Record feedback only when it actually arrives.
items.stop_condition: Do not count an invitation, a prepared packet or a CI run as external review.

items.question: Is the judge correct for every near-correct answer?
items.known: Three guard conditions are covered by 22 synthetic answers and 20 ablations, with an independent re-implementation agreeing on all 36 published guard verdicts. This is not a proof over all encodings.
items.impact: Do not convert 22 passing expectations into a general judge-correctness rate.
items.next_action: Accept a new counterexample only together with a concrete completion condition and a named rule version.
items.stop_condition: Stop extending the judge without a new counterexample. Do not add examples to raise the count.

items.question: Did the W02 window disappear before relaunch?
items.known: A normal close command was sent, but the immediately collected inventory still listed the product, and the relaunch happened before an absent-window observation. Final bytes pass; the intervention itself is unverified.
items.impact: W02 stays unknown in the ledger: no score, no product failure.
items.next_action: Nothing. The historical interval cannot be recaptured; the separately registered R01/R02 pair covers the prospective version of the question.
items.stop_condition: Stop this batch without replacement runs.

items.question: Were the attached bytes preserved in product-managed cloud storage?
items.known: The before/after native Save As retrieved the original message and the existing Stage A bytes in both arms while the host source was still present. That verifies local UI retrieval, not an independent cloud copy.
items.impact: Attachment-card continuity and stored-byte preservation stay separate; neither gets a zero nor a full score.
items.next_action: Reopen only with an official retrieval or provenance interface that can distinguish a product-managed copy from the retained host source.
items.stop_condition: Stop this metric in the current design; do not infer storage from model recall.
